recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-34165 unless a later work group decision changes the CanonicalResource description pattern for DeviceDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-34165 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core OO change request for R5 asking DeviceDefinition to add a top-level description element, 0..1 markdown, defined as additional information to describe the device for GUDID/EUDAMED catalog use.
initial_application: Jira records an implementation comment from John D.L. Nolen linking commit f82bd39a25f0b8666432d511207879bd32f99616. That commit added DeviceDefinition.description to source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml with min 0, max 1, and type markdown.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-42900 CanonicalResource work changed the surrounding DeviceDefinition model and replaced the original terse description prose with current CanonicalResource-style wording, but preserved DeviceDefinition.description as 0..1 markdown. OO Catalog Confluence minutes record both the FHIR-34165 vote and that JD applied it. No relevant conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source already satisfies FHIR-34165, and changing the wording back to the original request text would undo later modeling work without adding necessary implementer guidance.

related_jiras.note: Later DeviceDefinition CanonicalResource refactor changed the active description wording while preserving the 0..1 markdown element needed for FHIR-34165; not decided because it is a separate later issue and not required for this seed.
